import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
from tqdm import tqdm
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("input/ru_train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("input/ru_test_2.csv")
sample_submission_df = pd.read_csv("input/ru_sample_submission_2.csv")

print(f"Training samples: {len(train_df)}")
print(f"Test samples: {len(test_df)}")


# Build a bag-of-tokens representation using n-grams
def prepare_tokens(df):
    """Convert tokens to numerical representation"""
    df_with_ids = df.copy()

    # For training: create left and right neighbor indices
    df_with_ids["left_token_id"] = df_with_ids.groupby("sentence_id").apply(
        lambda x: np.array(
            [x["token_id"].iloc[i] if i > 0 else None for i in range(len(x))]
        )[-1].tolist()
    )
    df_with_ids["right_token_id"] = df_with_ids.groupby("sentence_id").apply(
        lambda x: np.array(
            [
                x["token_id"].iloc[i + 1] if i + 1 < len(x) else None
                for i in range(len(x) - 1)
            ]
        )[:-1].tolist()
    )

    return df_with_ids


train_processed = prepare_tokens(train_df)
test_processed = prepare_tokens(test_df)

# Get vocabulary from training data (output tokens)
vocab_list = list(train_df["after"].unique())
print(f"Output vocabulary size: {len(vocab_list)}")

# One-hot encode or use label encoding for simpler mapping
output_labeler = None
class_to_idx = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(vocab_list[:10000])}
idx_to_class = {i: c for c, i in class_to_idx.items()}


# Feature extraction: use character n-grams from before column
def create_ngram_features(text, n=5):
    features = np.zeros((n, 1))
    seen = set()
    for i in range(n):
        substr = text[i : i + n] if len(text) >= i + n else text
        if substr not in seen:
            seen.add(substr)
            features[0] += 1
    return features.sum().astype(float)

    lambda x: len(set(str(x)[:10])) if isinstance(x, str) else 0
)
train_processed["char_len_before"] = train_processed["before"].apply(
    lambda x: len(str(x))
)
train_processed["word_num_before"] = train_processed["before"].apply(
    lambda x: str(x).split() if isinstance(x, str) else []
)
train_processed["is_uppercase"] = train_processed["before"].apply(
    lambda x: str(x).upper() == str(x)
)
train_processed["has_number"] = train_processed["before"].apply(

)

test_processed["features_left"] = test_processed["before"].apply(

test_processed["char_len_before"] = test_processed["before"].apply(

)
test_processed["word_num_before"] = test_processed["before"].apply(
    lambda x: str(x).split() if isinstance(x, str) else []
)
test_processed["is_uppercase"] = test_processed["before"].apply(
    lambda x: str(x).upper() == str(x)
)
test_processed["has_number"] = test_processed["before"].apply(
    lambda x: any(c.isdigit() for c in str(x) if isinstance(x, str))
)

# Prepare features matrix (simplified)
train_features = train_processed[["features_left", "char_len_before"]].values
train_labels = train_processed["after"].values.astype(np.int64)
vocab_size = len(train_processed["after"].unique())

# Split for validation
X_val, y_val, X_train_full, y_train_full = train_test_split(
    train_labels, train_features, test_size=0.1, random_state=42
)

# Map labels to index
vocab_mapping = {}
for label, vocab_item in zip(
    y_train_full, [item for item in train_processed["after"].unique()]
):
    vocab_mapping[label] = vocab_item
vocab_to_idx = {v: i for i, v in enumerate(list(vocab_to_idx.keys()))}

# Simple approach: predict most common token type based on features
model = GradientBoostingClassifier(
    n_estimators=50, learning_rate=0.1, max_depth=3, random_state=42
)
model.fit(X_train_full, y_train_full)

# Predict on validation set
val_predictions = model.predict(X_val)

# Convert back to actual token values
val_preds_str = [list(set(vocab_list[:10000]))]

# Calculate final metric
correct = sum(val_predictions == y_val)
accuracy = correct / len(y_val) * 100

# Save predictions for all test data
submission_df = sample_submission_df.copy()

# Generate predictions for test data using same approach

for idx in test_processed.index:
    features = test_processed.loc[idx, :].to_dict()
    feature_vec = np.array([[features["features_left"]], [features["char_len_before"]]])

    # Predict
    pred_idx = model.predict(feature_vec)[0]
    pred_token = vocab_mapping[pred_idx]

    token_pred_id = f"{test_processed.loc[idx, 'sentence_id']}_{test_processed.loc[idx, 'token_id']}"
    submission_df = submission_df.append(
        {"id": token_pred_id, "after": pred_token}, ignore_index=True
    )

# Sort by id for consistency
submission_df.sort_values("id", inplace=True)
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

# Final calculation using cross-validation style hold-out
print(f"\nValidation Accuracy Score: {accuracy:.4f}")
